phrases.text: 00:00. Fresh page. Same slightly flattened fish.
Four zeroes. A pleasingly low number of expectations.
Midnight. Yesterday can keep its own sighs.
01:23. Even the clock takes things one step at a time.
One, two, three. Exhausting. A short pause seems fair.
It's 01:23. No need to skip straight to the ending.
05:20. A tiny fond thought. No announcement necessary.
5:20. I like having you around. Said very quietly.
05:20. Sending a little kindness, at a reasonable volume.
08:08. Fish online. Enthusiasm still loading.
Two eights, both upright. Show-offs. It's only 08:08.
08:08. Open for business. Mostly the business of sitting here.
09:09. A steady pace is still a pace. Mine barely registers.
Two nines. A little patience, with a spare for later.
It's 09:09. Saving some energy for the part after this part.
11:11. Make a wish. I'll pretend I didn't hear it.
Four ones. I wish for fewer things to be a whole thing.
11:11. Your wish does not need a project plan yet.
12:34. The numbers are organized. Good for them.
One, two, three, four. Steps, not a demand to hurry.
12:34. One thing at a time would be a lovely invention.
13:14. No grand speech. Just a fish keeping you company.
It's 13:14. Forever is a lot. This little moment will do.
13:14. Quiet company counts. Convenient, given my energy level.
5:20 PM. A small confession: this is nice, being here with you.
17:20. Quite fond of you, actually. Anyway. Weather.
Evening 5:20. A little affection. No reply form attached.
20:20. Looking back, the small good bits deserve some space too.
20:20. Today's review: still flat. Some things are dependable.
Two twenties. Take a second look at something that went okay.
22:22. Double helpings of doing very little, please.
Four twos. I'll take that as permission for two deep breaths.
22:22. Rest can have an encore. I checked with myself.
23:59. One minute left. We don't have to fill it.
A minute to midnight. Bookmark the unfinished thoughts.
23:59. Tomorrow's fish can handle being tomorrow's fish.
